claims.quote: Nannostomus mortenthaleri from Peru was the most beautiful new discovery in aquatics in 2000.
The coral red pencilfish, Nannostomus mortenthaleri, is a lebiasinid that appears endemic to the Nanay basin and Río Tigre system in Loreto, Peru.
